examples.name: Maple Street Neighbors
examples.q: What did we decide about the garden?
examples.a: Four new raised beds along the south fence. The water question goes to the spring meeting.
p: Agreed: four new raised beds along the south fence. Water access goes to the spring meeting.

examples.name: Juniper Village
examples.q: Who ran the kitchen rota last year?
examples.a: Three volunteers shared it in week-long shifts. Their handover notes list what they would change.
p: Three of us shared the rota, one week each. Next time, start the sign-up sheet before arrival day.

examples.name: Willow House
examples.q: Has anyone looked at the back steps?
examples.a: Yes. The March meeting agreed to get three quotes before the spring meeting.
p: Two treads are loose. Agreed to get three quotes before the spring meeting.

examples.name: Open Docs Guild
examples.q: How do new members get review rights?
examples.a: After two merged contributions, any maintainer can propose you. The guild confirms at its monthly call.
p: After two merged contributions any maintainer may propose a member. The monthly call confirms.
Rights lapse after a quiet year.
